svg.title: Four rules mapped in the kx plane: air

cc:Work.dc:title: Four rules mapped in the kx plane: air
cc:Work.dc:description: Colour shows the selected root's quadrant and thick lines show branch cuts. Path D (Wavebit before 2026-10-02) cuts the evanescent real-axis interval. Path E cuts straight up/down from each branch point. Maystre (current Wavebit) cuts along half-hyperbolas curving from the branch points. fmmax cuts the propagating real-axis interval and imaginary axis.
